classification: Level-3 complete access-path diagnostics; recent writes, no explicit cache eviction
client_transport: Messenger v2 secure for both paths
durability: file fsync, close, rename and whole-client/filesystem sync before ACK
limits: Only 1000 operations per cell; p99 is an unstable small-sample observation, p99.9 unavailable.
Rates use sums of timed operations, excluding generation, local witness fsync, connection setup and verification orchestration.
QEMU emulation, shared physical host and fixed one-worker load limit extrapolation. No global winner claim.
Physical cache residency is unverified; this is not a physical cold-cache comparison.
SDK cross-directory rename (/staging to /objects) differs from kernel same-directory rename. Results do not isolate client-layer overhead.
Native guest I/O deltas include all verification and background work in the comparison window; they cannot be attributed to individual paths.
No compaction/codec comparison: compression disabled; high-entropy data; storage ratios include replication, metadata and allocation.

environment.cotenancy: Only this CephFS example; no other heavy lab.

limits: Sample-window deltas exclude startup and exit outside observation. Decreasing counters are treated as restarts and the new counter is accumulated; reset intervals have no CPU utilization estimate.
Short-lived actors may be missed; use native pre-exit cgroup counters as well.
CPU utilization is interval-average percent of one core; short spikes may be missed.
Docker disk bytes are not device I/O latency; absent counters are unavailable, not zero.
